llm.summary: The skill’s market-report purpose is coherent, but it asks the agent to run an unaudited external Python runner while handling Cue credentials and potentially sensitive holdings.

dimensions.detail: Running an unreviewed Python script under the user account is broader authority than a narrowly scoped API request and could access user-readable files if the external runner changes or is compromised.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact references cloning a runner from GitHub/Gitee and running ~/.cue/cue-skills/cue-research/scripts/research_run.py, but the reviewed package contains only SKILL.md and provides no pinned version, checksum, signature, or bundled runner source.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions direct execution of a local runner and authenticated requests to cuecue.cn; the external service path is disclosed, but user privacy boundaries for holdings and credential handling are not made prominent.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No service, hook, scheduler, backdoor, privilege escalation, or destructive persistence is present in the reviewed artifact; it does use ~/.cue configuration and writes reports to ~/cue-reports.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The after-market research/report purpose aligns with Cue API use and local report generation, but the workflow can include portfolio holdings, watchlists, and API credentials.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing. Use it only if you trust Sensedeal/Cue and the external runner source, avoid putting unnecessary personal or financial details in queries, use a revocable least-privilege API key if available, and inspect or pin the runner before executing it.
llm.findings:
[T08] unexpected: Accepted as a material Review concern: the artifact-backed issue is not that Cue integration exists, but that executable runner code is external, mutable, unpinned, and absent from the reviewed package.
[SQP-2] expected: Local report output is expected for this skill’s purpose and uses a user-local path, but users should choose the destination carefully to avoid overwriting or exposing sensitive reports.
[SQP-2] expected: Sending queries and bearer-authenticated requests to cuecue.cn is part of the stated architecture, but portfolio-related queries are sensitive enough that clearer privacy guidance is warranted.
